name: iam_policy_change
title: Cloud IAM policy change
rationale: Policy updates can grant privilege or introduce new principals.
false_positive: Approved infrastructure deployments routinely change policy.
tuning: Baseline deployment identities and correlate the policy delta before escalation.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: service_account_key
title: Service account key creation
rationale: New user-managed keys can provide durable access.
false_positive: Legacy workloads may rotate keys legitimately.
tuning: Allowlist documented exceptions and prefer workload identity.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: logging_sink_change
title: Logging sink modification
rationale: Changing routing can hide future activity from security monitoring.
false_positive: Platform maintenance may change sink filters.
tuning: Review the destination and filter diff against change tickets.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: firewall_change
title: Cloud firewall rule change
rationale: A rule change may widen the reachable network surface.
tuning: Review source ranges, target tags and change approvals.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: aws_role_policy
title: AWS role policy attachment
rationale: A new policy attachment may expand the permissions of a role.
false_positive: IaC deployments can legitimately attach policies.
tuning: Compare against the AWS change record and inspect policy permissions.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: aws_bucket_policy
title: AWS bucket policy change
rationale: A policy update can broaden object access.
false_positive: Routine remediation and deployment may change policies.
tuning: Inspect the new policy and block-public-access configuration.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: repeated_failures
title: Repeated login failures
rationale: Repeated failures for one identity can indicate password guessing.
false_positive: Expired secrets and typing errors can produce repeated failures.
tuning: Baseline service identities and tune threshold by authentication provider.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: password_spray
title: Password spray from one IP
rationale: One IP failing against multiple identities can indicate password spraying.
false_positive: NAT or a misconfigured proxy can aggregate unrelated attempts.
tuning: Baseline shared egress and require more distinct users in noisy segments.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: fail_then_success
title: Login success after repeated failures
rationale: A successful sign-in after repeated failures may indicate credential compromise.
false_positive: A legitimate user can eventually enter the correct password.
tuning: Confirm device, MFA and source IP with the identity owner.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: rapid_country_change
title: Rapid sign-ins from different countries
rationale: A principal signing in from different countries rapidly may indicate account misuse.
false_positive: VPN exits and IP geolocation errors are common.
tuning: Use known VPN ranges and managed-device context.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: encoded_powershell
title: Encoded PowerShell invocation
rationale: Encoded arguments can conceal a script payload.
false_positive: Deployment tooling also uses encoded commands.
tuning: Inspect the process tree and decode the payload offline.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: office_shell
title: Office application spawning a shell
rationale: A shell launched by Office can indicate malicious document execution.
false_positive: Some legacy macros invoke approved command-line tools.
tuning: Check file provenance and allowlist signed workflow tools.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: run_key
title: Windows Run key modification
rationale: A Run key value can establish logon persistence.
false_positive: Installers and legitimate startup software create Run values.
tuning: Inspect the registry value, writing process and signer.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: smb_lateral
title: Remote SMB connection
rationale: An endpoint reaching TCP/445 can indicate remote service activity.
false_positive: File servers and administrative tooling use SMB routinely.
tuning: Baseline approved file servers and verify destination and process.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: dns_long_labels
title: Repeated long DNS labels
rationale: Repeated long labels can carry encoded data.
false_positive: Telemetry and CDNs may use long labels.
tuning: Baseline domains and inspect entropy and query volume.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: repeated_alt_port
title: Repeated traffic to alternate C2 port
rationale: Repeated permitted outbound sessions to port 4444 warrant investigation.
false_positive: Authorized diagnostic tools can use the same port.
tuning: Inspect destinations and baseline approved services. Check periodicity separately.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: large_egress
title: Large permitted outbound transfer
rationale: A single outbound session over 100 MiB can indicate bulk transfer.
false_positive: Backups and artifact publishing may transfer large objects.
tuning: Baseline traffic by source and destination. Verify whether data was authorized.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: cloud_object_reads
title: Burst of cloud object reads
rationale: A burst of object reads by one identity may precede exfiltration.
false_positive: Batch ETL and backups often read many objects.
tuning: Tune to workload baselines and correlate with egress.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.

name: login_then_iam
title: Sign-in followed by IAM change
rationale: An authentication followed by a cloud policy update can reveal abuse of a federated identity.
false_positive: Operators may sign in just before an approved change.
tuning: Match canonical identity across providers and check ticket, MFA and policy delta.
expected: Positive fixture alerts and nearby negative fixture remains quiet.
